name: Myconian Ambassador Resort
insider_take: This Relais & Châteaux gem perches dramatically on Platis Gialos beach, where Cycladic elegance meets barefoot luxury in one of Mykonos' most prestigious addresses.
whats_special: The resort sits on the island's most coveted stretch of golden sand, just minutes from the legendary windmills that have guided sailors since the 16th century. As part of the exclusive Relais & Châteaux collection, it's one of only a handful of properties in the Greek islands to earn this prestigious designation for culinary excellence and hospitality.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's terrace restaurant - you'll have front-row seats to watch the sun dip behind Delos, the mythical birthplace of Apollo, creating one of the Aegean's most spectacular light shows.
dont_miss: The nearby archaeological site of Delos is just a 30-minute boat ride away and offers some of Greece's most important ancient ruins. Back on Mykonos, the iconic Panagia Paraportiani church - actually five small churches built into one - sits in nearby Mykonos Town and is considered one of the most photographed churches in the world.
pros: Exclusive Relais & Châteaux luxury collection membership
Prime Mykonos location with stunning Aegean Sea views
Sophisticated Greek island architecture and design
Premium thalassotherapy spa and wellness facilities
cons: Seasonal operation typical of Greek island resorts
